c196_preselected.metric_primary: RQA ratio ENTR/DIV on delay-embedded log-volume returns. ENTR = entropy of the qualifying diagonal line length distribution (Shannon, nats), computed as -sum_k p_k*ln(p_k) over k>=l_min with n_k>0 (standard RQA ENTR; same distribution shape but used as ratio numerator). DIV = divergence = 1/L_MAX where L_MAX=max qualifying diagonal line length k>=l_min excl LOI. RATIO_ENTR_DIV = ENTR/DIV. m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,l_min=2. Fail-closed NaN/no-signal if ENTR undefined/non-finite/degenerate (<2 distinct qualifying lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive), DIV/L_MAX invalid (L_MAX<=0/non-finite or no qualifying diagonal lines), ratio non-finite, or insufficient qualifying lines/points. Trailing/causal only.
c196_preselected.selection_note: Distinct pairing (ENTR/DIV) not used in C125-C195; preselect grep 0 observed at C195 completion. Re-verify 0 non-self at C196 run time.
